items.text: Title tag is 50–60 characters and places the primary keyword near the start.
Meta description is 150–160 characters and contains keyword, benefit, and soft CTA.
Canonical URL is set.
Open Graph title, description, 1200×630 image, URL, and type are set.
Twitter summary-large-image card, title, description, and image are set.
HTML language attribute is set.
Viewport meta is set.
Favicon and apple-touch-icon are set.
UTF-8 charset meta is set.
Slug is under 60 characters.
Primary keyword occurs in the slug.
Slug uses hyphens, not underscores.
Slug is lowercase.
Slug omits unnecessary stop words.
URL follows a logical hierarchy.
Page has exactly one H1 containing the primary keyword.
H2-to-H3 hierarchy is logical and skips no levels.
H2s use relevant supporting keywords and researched questions.
Headings and copy avoid keyword stuffing.
Primary keyword appears in the first 100 words.
First paragraph directly answers the query.
Length is within 20% of the measured top-three SERP average.
Paragraphs contain one to four sentences.
Readability is approximately 8th–10th grade.
Active voice is preferred.
Key phrases are bolded sparingly.
Bullets and numbered lists are used where appropriate.
FAQ contains four to eight questions from real question and PAA research.
Answers are direct, two to four sentences, researched, and cited where factual.
Eligible visible FAQ content has matching FAQPage JSON-LD.
Alt text describes each image and uses keywords only where natural.
Image filenames are descriptive and hyphenated.
Content images are WebP and below 200 KB.
Image width and height are specified.
Below-fold images are lazy-loaded.
Responsive srcset is supplied where needed.
A featured or hero image supports social sharing.
Post includes three to five internal links, or more when pillar depth warrants it.
Links connect related posts and relevant service, category, or tool pages.
Anchor text is descriptive and not generic.
Links are contextually placed in body copy.
Applicable pages display breadcrumbs.
Page cites two to three authoritative external sources.
External sources are relevant to the topic.
New-tab external links use rel=noopener.
Sponsored and affiliate links use the required nofollow and sponsored values.
Blog posts use Article schema.
Applicable service businesses use the most specific LocalBusiness subtype.
Applicable service pages use Service schema.
Eligible visible FAQs use FAQPage schema.
Applicable pages use BreadcrumbList schema.
Site-wide Organization schema is truthful.
Real bylines use Author or Person schema.
Eligible step-by-step content uses HowTo schema.
Genuine roundup posts use ItemList with nested Review.
Genuine individual reviews use Product with Review.
Each blog post has a real author byline.
Author bio contains verifiable credentials.
Author byline links to a dedicated author page.
Published date is displayed.
Last-updated date appears only after a genuine refresh.
Stories, numbers, and opinions come from approved real sources.
Body cites authoritative sources.
About page contains truthful credentials.
Contact page contains only real available contact details.
First-person experience in the opening is genuine.
Page uses semantic HTML5 landmarks.
Interactive elements have ARIA labels where needed.
Body-text contrast meets WCAG AA 4.5:1.
Interactive elements have visible focus indicators.
Every image has descriptive or intentionally empty alt text.
Link text is descriptive.
Keyboard users have a skip-to-content link.
Layout is responsive.
Touch targets are at least 48×48 pixels.
Body font is at least 16 pixels.
Tested viewports have no horizontal scroll.
Page has no intrusive interstitials.
Open Graph image is 1200×630 and below 1 MB.
Separate Twitter Card image is 1200×600.
Open Graph description is compelling and differs from meta only when valuable.
Applicable visual niches provide a 1000×1500 Pinterest image.
Primary CTA appears above the fold.
Real phone number supports click-to-call.
Page contains multiple appropriate CTA placements.
Trust signals are truthful.
Testimonials identify real consenting people.
Service-area coverage is truthful.
Business hours are displayed.
Real public address is displayed with a map.
Primary CTA is the appropriate newsletter or product action.
Affiliate disclosure appears above the fold when affiliate links exist.
Appropriate channel-follow action is provided.
Language or region indicator is provided.
Table of contents with anchor links appears at the top.
Every H2 has a jump link.
Page provides a back-to-top button.
Reading-progress bar is used where appropriate.
Estimated reading time is displayed.
